neighbours.label: modifier announcing a short promotional or preview excerpt of media (' preview', ' teaser', ' highlight', ' promotional', '30-second') just before 'clip / trailer / reel / highlights'
fire: Before the album came out, the band put a 20-second preview clip on their site.
The channel showed a quick highlight package from Saturday's race.
A new teaser for the series appeared online this morning.
The distributor mailed promotional trailers to cinemas across the country.
Visitors to the store can listen to a preview snippet of each song.
At halftime the broadcaster ran a short highlight reel of the first half.
The developer showed a brief teaser video at the end of the conference.
The festival's site now has a promotional clip for every film in competition.
quiet: Before the album came out, the band rehearsed for weeks in a rented barn.
The channel showed the entire race from Saturday without a break.
A new season of the series was filmed in Iceland this spring.
The distributor mailed invoices to cinemas across the country.
Visitors to the store can buy vinyl copies of each album.
At halftime the broadcaster interviewed the two head coaches.
The developer answered questions from the audience at the conference.
The festival's jury watched every feature in competition from start to finish.

notes: Card: no single token; - pole promotes ' trailer', ' highlights', ' clip'. Probe: teaser 0.73, highlight 0.80, but 'the full film' also 0.36, so near misses about whole works may leak.
